question: The maximum length of the touch line in a football match is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 110 m.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The touchline is also known as the sideline and is one of the boundaries of the football field.**
 
• ** According to the Laws of the Game set by the International Football Association Board (IFAB), the touchline should measure between 100-110 meters (110-120 yards) in length.**
 
• The exact length can vary depending on the stadium and the level of the competition being played.
 
• The field of play is rectangular and marked with lines called boundary lines.
